programs.title: Malicious Mind Games
programs.desc: A widowed mother working a nighttime shift as a security guard thinks she's witnessed a murder. Determined to prove her sleep deprivation isn't clouding her judgment, she attempts to prove that something sinister is happening under everyone's noses.

programs.title: Sins of the Preacher's Wife
programs.desc: Welcomed with open arms by a preacher's wife, a young mother enrolls her baby in a day care program at a local church. However, the preacher's wife soon becomes obsessed with the child and tries to frame the woman as an unfit mom.

programs.title: Deadly Wives Club
programs.desc: Anita Jackson is thrilled when she and her husband move to an exclusive neighborhood with their adopted daughter, Jilly. However, she soon becomes suspicious when the other wives start paying more attention to Jilly than to her.

programs.title: Secret Life of a Good Wife
programs.desc: Jenna is an influencer with a traumatic past who finds peace, love and internet fame as a traditional housewife. When her mother goes missing, she soon realizes the kind and loving community she's come to rely on harbors dark secrets.

programs.title: The Widow's Payback
programs.desc: Devastated by the murder of her husband, a woman assumes a new identity and seduces the criminal mastermind behind his death. As she gains his trust and penetrates his inner circle, she risks everything to expose the truth and fight for justice.

programs.title: Hunting Housewives
programs.desc: A weekend getaway turns into a living nightmare when a plane crash leaves four housewives stranded in the wilderness. When they suddenly realize they're not alone, they must band together to outwit their hunters and make it out alive.
